## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT token (likely authentication related).

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /api/visitorwidget/widgetversions/{widgetversionId}` — Retrieve a specific version of a visitor widget.
- `GET /listings/homepage` — Retrieve listings for the homepage.
- `GET /pagead/attribution/wcm` — Retrieve attribution data for page ads.
- `GET /wp-json/contact-form-7/v1/contact-forms/{contact-formId}/feedback/schema` — Get the schema for contact form feedback.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /ablincoln/vuid` — Submit a visitor ID associated with A/B testing.
- `POST /add/player-stats` — Submit player statistics data.

### Core API (2)
- `POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php` — Submit AJAX requests to the WordPress admin.
- `POST /wp-content/plugins/litespeed-cache/guest.vary.php` — Likely related to cache; agent use unclear.
